description: Personal dotfiles managed by yadm + Git working copy for documentation

docs.purpose: Documentation and guides for Claude instances

commit_guidelines.frequency: After each logical change that is independently testable
commit_guidelines.definition: A change that modifies ONE aspect and can be verified as working
examples: DOT-001: Add install.sh for fresh macOS
anti_patterns: DOT-001: Add .mcp.json with GitHub MCP server config and update .zshrc (too long, multiple changes)

workflow.before_commit: Check if issue exists for this work
workflow.create_issue: For any new feature or significant change
workflow.update_status: When starting, blocking, or completing work

workflow_rules.branch_check: Always run: git branch (before any changes)

tool_selection.if_on_main: Use only yadm for home directory files
tool_selection.if_on_docs: Use only git for documentation files
tool_selection.never_mix: Do not use git add on main or yadm on docs

push_workflow.on_main: yadm push → goes to bare repo in $HOME
push_workflow.user_syncs: User runs: git pull (from bare) then git push (to GitHub)

claude_instance_notes.note_1: This is a testing/working copy, not the actual home directory
claude_instance_notes.note_2: You work here, user syncs to GitHub
claude_instance_notes.note_3: You modify files in this repo, not directly in $HOME

claude_autonomy.instructions: Claude instances should work autonomously in this repository
claude_autonomy.explanation: You can run bash, git, and other commands without asking permission
workflow: Use git add and git commit automatically

permissions.run_bash: Yes - execute any bash commands needed
permissions.modify_files: Yes - edit files as needed for tasks
permissions.create_commits: Yes - commit atomically with each logical change
permissions.run_git_commands: Yes - git add, commit, push as needed

issue_workflow.before_starting: Find matching issue in .issues/ or create new one
issue_workflow.during_work: Mark issue as IN_PROGRESS, update acceptance criteria
issue_workflow.when_done: Mark issue as DONE, link commit hash in Related Commits
issue_workflow.fail_safe: If unsure, create issue first and ask user for confirmation

claude_autonomy.context: User has approved autonomous work in this repository
